text:
ashwin: morning — quick async standup. TL;DR: merged microbatch scoring change (PR #4823), saw ~5-8% p99 win on local bench. Canary looks okay so far but KV eviction test flapping: canary node OOMs on slot 3. Blocker: need triage on eviction/race before we promote. Today: perf sweep at 10:30 PT, will post numbers and flamegraphs.

maria: nice — congrats on the p99 win. can you paste the bench command & flamegraph path? I'll try to repro locally. :mag:

ashwin: sure — bench command I run is:```bash
./bench/run_microbatch.sh --model rdl-7b --seq 1024 --iters 200 --tag local-try
```flamegraph (raw): s3://redwood-artifacts/bench/rdl-7b/local-try/2026-03-18/flame.svg

kevin: I can pick up the eviction triage after my sync. which canary cluster/tag is showing the OOM?

ashwin: canary-7, tag=vm-2026-03-18. crash trace (short):```
2026-03-18T16:05:12Z kernel: allocation failed: requested 1.2G, available 0.9G
stack: alloc_chunk -> serve_step -> kv_evict_path -> on_request
```looks like allocation after KV eviction path.

lisa: fwiw I rolled a throttle tweak to cache.eviction_threshold yesterday to 0.65 — might be related. reverting that now and re-deploying to canary-7 :arrows_counterclockwise:

ci-bot: PR #4823 merged by ashwin — all CI checks passed. Canary deployment started to canary-7. (links: https://ci.redwood/4823)

oliver: pinging @mike-oncall in #eng-oncall in case canary health degrades — can we get eyes?

mike-oncall: oncall here, watching metrics and alerts. if memory spikes above threshold i'll cut the canary and roll back. keep me posted.

maria: repro started locally, currently iter 40/200. initial p99 numbers look similar to ashwin's. will share full numbers + trace by 10:05 PT.

ashwin: awesome, thanks. blocker = triage until we know if revert fixes. if revert doesn't help, we'll instrument KV eviction path with extra alloc logging and run a targeted canary.

kevin: noted — i'll queue time after my sync to look at logs & heap maps. if you can share the canary heap snapshot path after it OOMs that'd help.

lisa: revert pushed and rolling now, ETA ~5m. i'll post rollout status.

ashwin: thanks all. today I'm: 1) run perf sweep (10:30 PT), 2) follow up on canary health, 3) add extra KV alloc logging if revert doesn't fix. blocker: waiting on triage + heap snapshot.

maria: update — local bench finished: p99 down 6.2% vs main, avg token cost -2.8%. uploading artifacts to s3 and will paste link.

ci-bot: canary-7 deployment status: still healthy (10:13 PT) — 3/4 nodes healthy, 1 node restarted (no alert).

ashwin: great. will keep thread updated. cheers :coffee:
